summary: Implemented a frontend shared-code gate screen and updated the Admin route guard/layout to require shared-code verification (with sessionStorage) before rendering admin UI. Added frontend hooks and an Admin Access page plus navigation entry. Backend was modified to include shared-code verification and attempt tracking, but the diff is truncated and shows trap-based failures, a 3-attempt limit, and no clear evidence that all admin-only methods and required query APIs were fully updated.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must enforce shared-code session marker for all admin-only backend operations (in addition to existing admin permission checks).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a helper `requireAdminSharedCodeSession` but does not show it being applied across all admin-only methods; the backend diff is truncated before any such updates are visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend should provide clear success/fail responses for verification and lockout rather than trapping, including lockout after too many attempts (e.g., 5) with cooldown responses.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend verification methods shown use `Runtime.trap(...)` for incorrect code and lockout conditions, which contradicts the AC stating attempts should "return a clear failure state rather than trapping." Also `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3`, not the suggested 5 attempts in the requirement/AC example.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated): `Runtime.trap("This account is currently locked out...")`

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend should expose an API to check whether the caller currently has a valid shared-code session marker (used by the frontend to avoid prompting when still valid).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.hasValidAdminSharedCode()`, but no corresponding backend method is shown in the truncated backend diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must provide admin-only APIs to list/grant/revoke admin access (and these must be protected by BOTH admin permission and shared-code session marker).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.listAdminUsers()`, `actor.grantAdminAccess(...)`, and `actor.revokeAdminAccess(...)`, but the backend diff shown does not include these methods or evidence they are protected by the shared-code session requirement (backend diff is truncated).

hallucinated_features.description: Large-scale frontend theming/SEO/site feature changes (e.g., medieval-fantasy design system, SEO meta hooks, homepage/about/services/shop content updates, various UI components) unrelated to shared-code gated admin access and admin permission management.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest scope is specifically shared-code gating + admin permission management; it explicitly cautions against expanding unrelated sections. The diff summary indicates many broad UI/content/theme changes not required to satisfy REQ-21..24.
